title: DOE and Battelle Institute as UFO secret keepers

tellings.quote: I kept poting the doe I kept asking about why people weren't Looking At Doe I kept asking why people weren't looking at the battel Institute

plain: A researcher named Bob Maguire, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says he kept pointing people toward the Department of Energy, the US government agency that runs the country's nuclear weapons labs, and toward the Battelle Institute, a private research organisation. He says he kept asking why nobody was looking at them as places where UFO secrets might be kept, and he credits the idea in part to a woman named Linda Thompson. If he were right, the hidden story would sit somewhere other than the military, where most people look.
